query.comment: Simulate temperature traces over bounded time horizon to visually inspect spike events and stabilization behavior
Check whether a spike state is reachable in at least one execution path
Check whether the system can reach a stabilized state in at least one execution path
Check whether there exists a run where a spike occurs and stabilization is eventually reached afterward
Ensure temperature always remains within safe operating bounds in all states
Ensure the system is deadlock-free in all reachable states
Check whether spike eventually occurs on all execution paths (liveness requirement)
Check whether all executions eventually reach a stabilized state
Check whether all executions eventually include both spike occurrence and subsequent stabilization
Compute probability that a spike occurs within the given time bound
Compute probability that the system stabilizes within the given time bound
Compute probability that a spike occurs followed by stabilization within the time bound
